Hero.headline: Your on-the-ground production partner in Central America.
Hero.sub: From fixer services and scouting to permits, crew, logistics, and field execution, we support international productions across Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, and southern Mexico.
Hero.imageAlt: Timelapse of city lights and production energy

About.body: Girón & Schwartz is a hands-on production company built through years of experience on the ground in Guatemala and the region. Our work is rooted in close collaboration, direct communication, and a strong understanding of how productions move in real conditions. We stay involved at every stage so that clients can work with a team that understands both the creative demands of a project and the realities required to carry it through.
About.manuelaBio: Manuela Girón is one of Guatemala’s most seasoned production professionals, with extensive experience in advertising, documentary, and unscripted productions. She has worked as a fixer, field producer, and assistant director, and is trusted to carry complex productions from the ground with authority and local experience.
About.luisBio: Luis is an audiovisual producer with experience in national and international productions, as well as a background in public administration, cultural management, and historical research. His understanding of institutions and territory makes him especially valuable on projects that require coordination and context.
About.testimonial1Quote: Reliable, thoughtful, and exceptionally well connected on the ground.
About.testimonial2Quote: A phenomenal network and a wealth of experience as fixers and consultants.
About.testimonial3Quote: The top production team in the region. Professional, trusted, easy to work with.
